style.name: Neo-brutalism
style.description: Neo-brutalist interfaces combine blunt geometry, strong outlines, hard offset shadows, and conspicuous color. Their playful directness makes hierarchy visible and gives ordinary controls a graphic, poster-like presence.

fonts.heading: Archivo Black
fonts.rationale: Dense display lettering gives headings punch while the geometric body face stays direct and usable.

tips: Use shadow direction to unify the interface.
Reserve the strongest color for primary actions.
avoid: Turning body copy into all caps.

recipe.composition: Build a blunt graphic hierarchy with thick rules, one oversized headline, and hard-edged panels.
recipe.motion: A pressed control moves into its offset shadow immediately; navigation stays direct.
recipe.signature: Heavy outlines and hard shadows give ordinary controls poster-like presence.
